title: Rescue Swimmers: Sew Others May Live
description: Petty Officer 2nd Class Dave Froehlich, a rescue swimmer at Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, N.J., discusses sewing Thursday, Oct. 8, 2015. Rescue swimmers become proficient in sewing at Aviation Survival Technician "A" school. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class David Micallef.
